steps.en: Install the SDK into your backend's Python environment
steps.zh: 把 SDK 装进你后端的 Python 环境

steps.en: Declare behavior as guidelines: a condition and the action it triggers
steps.zh: 把行为写成 guideline：一条条件加它触发的动作

steps.en: Register tools and bind them to the observation that gates them
steps.zh: 注册工具，并绑定允许它触发的 observation

steps.en: Per turn, match relevant guidelines/journeys/glossary into one narrowed context
steps.zh: 每轮只把相关的 guideline/journey/术语装配成收窄的上下文

steps.en: Generate the reply from that focused context — or pick a canned response when strict
steps.zh: 基于这份聚焦上下文生成回复——严格模式则改选预批模板

value.en: Hundreds of behavioral rules without prompt rot — the engine filters relevance, not the LLM
value.zh: 几百条行为规则也不会把 prompt 撑爆——过滤相关性的是引擎，不是大模型
